# @solana-programs/quarry-redeemer

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/quarry-redeemer.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-redeemer)

TypeScript client for the Quarry Redeemer program, which redeems IOU tokens for their underlying tokens

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/quarry-redeemer/. Edit programs/quarry-redeemer/README.md instead. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/quarry-redeemer @solana/kit
```

## About

Quarry Redeemer exchanges IOU tokens for their underlying redemption tokens.

[`@solana-programs/quarry`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry) bundles all six Quarry programs in one package.

## Usage

```typescript
import {
  findRedeemerPda,
  getRedeemTokensInstructionAsync,
} from "@solana-programs/quarry-redeemer";
```

## Program

- Name: `quarryRedeemer`
- Address: `QRDxhMw1P2NEfiw5mYXG79bwfgHTdasY2xNP76XSea9`
